messages:
alisa: Heads-up: sampleapp onboarding run hit repeated OOMs when users hit pagination fast (prefetch=3). Root cause looks like concurrent prefetch + token-refresh flood. Stack: Node 18, js-sdk v1.8.2, running in Dedicated small instance.

alisa: Repro: when client fetches page N, we kick off prefetch for N+1..N+3 and don't await; at scale this piles up memory + KV cache growth.

alisa: snippet:
```js
for (let i=0; i<3; i++) client.fetchPage(cur+1+i) // no await
```

matt: oof. are retries happening inside fetchPage? could be retry storm on 401->refresh->replay

alisa: yes, token refresh async triggers for many inflight requests; observed many Refresh calls in logs. Also saw 502/429s from backend triggering SDK retry loops.

jx: FYI js-sdk default concurrency window is 8 for sampleapp but python is 4. Might explain why js burns more memory. Also js retry policy uses exponential jitter with no max inflight cap.

sam: quick mitigation: cap prefetch to 1-2 and use an async semaphore. also add conditional await on cache-hit to short-circuit.

sam: sample patch:
```js
const sem = new Semaphore(3);
await sem.run(async () => fetchPage(n+1));
```

matt: can we add a client-side backpressure helper in devex SDK? like Paginator.prefetch(limit, concurrency) defaulting to safe values

alisa: would help. current pagination API is very minimal. Also the auth refresh API is not exposed for hooks — can't hook into "onRefresh" to serialize refreshes.

jx: noted. SDK parity task: python exposes on_token_refresh callback, js doesn't. I'll open a PR to add onTokenRefresh and configurable concurrency on paginator.

dev-bot: CI started for PR #4321 (jx/sdk-paginator-backpressure) :jenkins: 

matt: for immediate fix, infra side can bump instance mem and set process.env.PREFETCH=1 for onboarding jobs

alisa: doing that now. also adding logs for in-flight request count.

sam: let's add an e2e test that simulates 200 concurrent users doing fast scroll to catch regressions

alisa: +1. I'll paste a small load test script here later.

jx: created issue INF-789: SDK parity - paginator concurrency + token refresh hook

matt: thanks. followup: we should document recommended defaults in devex/playbooks.

alisa: done — updated onboarding runbook draft in #devex. will link later :thumbsup:
